style_suffix: Vox-style editorial mixed-media collage: real photographs cut out with thick white paper borders and soft drop shadows, layered on a {bg} textured paper background, halftone dot patterns, torn paper edges, washi tape strips, one or two bold flat geometric shapes in bright contrasting colors, magazine print texture, photorealistic photo elements, dramatic studio lighting, high contrast, vivid detail, main subject in the middle third, empty space in the top quarter, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no logos, 9:16 vertical aspect ratio
note: Vox photo-collage. Order = playback order. Beat 12 reuses 01.png for the seamless loop. No identifiable real people.
